title: Director of Marketing Manager
description:
Wayfair is seeking a Director of Marketing Manager who is passionate about building innovative solutions. This is an exciting opportunity to make a real impact in a fast-growing organization.

**About the Role:**
As a Director of Marketing Manager, you will play a key role in shaping the future of our marketing capabilities. You will work closely with our product, engineering, and business teams to deliver high-quality solutions.

**What You'll Do:**
- Lead and execute marketing initiatives from conception to delivery
- Work with stakeholders across the business to identify opportunities
- Develop and implement strategies that align with company goals
- Analyze data and metrics to measure impact and drive improvements
- Stay up-to-date with industry trends and best practices
- Build and maintain strong relationships with internal and external partners

**Your Background:**
- 8+ years of relevant experience
- Expertise in CRM, Microsoft Office, HubSpot, Analytical Thinking
- Proven track record of delivering results in a fast-paced environment
- Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills
- Excellent written and verbal communication abilities

**Compensation & Benefits:**
- Annual salary: NOK 1,600,000 – NOK 2,200,000
- 100% remote — work from anywhere
- Stock options / performance bonus
- Premium health insurance
- 401k/pension with company match
- Flexible working hours

title: Staff Copywriter
description:

Calendly is seeking a Mid-Level UI Designer who is passionate about building innovative solutions. This is an exciting opportunity to make a real impact in a fast-growing organization.

**About the Role:**
As a Mid-Level UI Designer, you will play a key role in shaping the future of our design capabilities. You will work closely with our product, engineering, and business teams to deliver high-quality solutions.

**What You'll Do:**
- Lead and execute design initiatives from conception to delivery
- Work with stakeholders across the business to identify opportunities
- Develop and implement strategies that align with company goals
- Analyze data and metrics to measure impact and drive improvements
- Stay up-to-date with industry trends and best practices
- Build and maintain strong relationships with internal and external partners

**Your Background:**
- 2+ years of relevant experience
- Expertise in Adobe XD, Team Management, Prototyping, Figma
- Proven track record of delivering results in a fast-paced environment
- Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills
- Excellent written and verbal communication abilities

**Compensation & Benefits:**
- Annual salary: NOK 650,000 – NOK 900,000
- 100% remote — work from anywhere
- Stock options / performance bonus
- Premium health insurance
- 401k/pension with company match
- Flexible working hours

- Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
- 100% remote — work from anywhere
- Generous PTO and paid holidays
- Learning and development budget
- Collaborative and inclusive work environment

Join NDT as a Staff Content Writer and be part of our mission to transform the industry. We're a team of driven professionals who love what we do and are committed to excellence.

**The Opportunity:**
We're expanding our team and looking for a skilled Staff Content Writer with strong expertise in marketing. This role offers tremendous growth potential and the chance to work on challenging, meaningful projects.

**Day-to-Day Responsibilities:**
- Plan, prioritize, and execute marketing projects to meet deadlines
- Collaborate with team members across departments
- Create detailed documentation and reports
- Conduct research and analysis to support decision-making
- Present findings and recommendations to leadership
- Continuously improve processes and workflows

**Must-Have Qualifications:**
- Minimum 1 years of experience as a Staff Content Writer or similar
- In-depth knowledge of Content Strategy, SEO, SEM, Project Management
- Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
- Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
- Team player with a proactive mindset

**Perks & Benefits:**
- Salary range: NOK 450,000 – NOK 650,000
- 100% remote — work from anywhere
- Health and wellness allowance
- Professional development opportunities
- Team offsites and company events
- Modern office with great amenities
